comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record loads a filled syringe into a pump.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate bends and pulls a wire while maintaining a blade under its latch; record gently aligns a syringe flange into a tight slot and advances a driver to contact without moving the plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective extraction; record requires precise syringe seating and driver contact with strict no-push/no-pull limits.
comparison.reason: Both demand fine force control, but the record tests gentle installation and contact without displacement rather than latch release.
